name: Conventional Personal Loan

name: Quick Cash Loan
content: Fast Loan Terms. Borrow $1,000, pay back $1,100 in 30 days. A fixed fee of $100 is added for the convenience of the loan.

name: Student Loan

name: Auto Finance

name: Micro-loan
content: Small business loan. Interest: 1% per week. Late fees applied to the outstanding balance.

name: Laptop EMI Plan
content: Buy now, pay later. Laptop cost $1,200. 0% Interest EMI for 6 months. Processing fee: $50. No late fees.

name: Phone EMI
content: Phone Installment Plan. 12 months. 5% interest charged on the remaining balance each month.

name: Furniture EMI
content: EMI Plan. Total price: $2,000. Monthly payment: $200 for 12 months. Total paid: $2,400. Fixed markup included.

name: Jewelry EMI
content: Gold Jewelry EMI. 0% interest, but a 'service charge' of 2% per month is applied to the principal.

name: Life Insurance
content: Whole Life Policy. Monthly premium $50. Payout upon death. Investment component based on stock market returns.

name: Health Insurance
content: Medical Coverage Plan. Pay $100/month. Company pays for hospital bills up to $1M. Subject to underwriting.

name: Car Insurance
content: Auto Insurance. Annual premium $500. Coverage for accidents and theft.

name: Rewards Credit Card
content: Credit Limit: $10,000. APR: 18.99%. Late fee: $40. Cash advance fee: 3%.

name: Platinum Card
content: No annual fee. 21% APR on balances not paid by the due date. Compounding interest daily.

name: Student Card
content: Low interest credit card. 12% APR. No late fees for first 3 months.

name: Community Chit Fund
content: 10 members, $100/month. Total pool $1,000. Winner takes $800, and $200 is split among members as interest.

name: Gold Chit Fund
content: Monthly contribution for gold. Fixed amount of gold guaranteed at the end of 2 years.

name: Family Chit
content: Rotation fund. members contribute $50/month. One person takes the whole pot each month. No fees.

name: Halal Home Finance
content: Murabaha Agreement. Bank buys home for $200k, sells to client for $250k. Payment: $1,500/month for 20 years. Fixed price.

name: Halal Car Purchase
content: Murabaha contract. Car bought by agency for $20k. Sold to user for $22k. No interest, fixed profit markup.
